audit_status.source_base: ChatGPT-authored Psalms completion draft using public-domain KJV as familiar alignment scaffold with curated Hebrew/textual overrides; full WLC/OSHB/source-witness audit pending
audit_status.review_note: Refuge, siege, shame, illness imagery, enemies, trust, truth, and committing one’s spirit.

verses.restored: In thee, O YHWH, do I put my trust; let me never be ashamed: deliver me in thy righteousness.

familiar.text: In thee, O LORD, do I put my trust; let me never be ashamed: deliver me in thy righteousness.

modern.text: In You, O LORD, I have taken refuge; let me never be put to shame; save me by Your righteousness.

original.text: לַמְנַצֵּ֗חַ מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִֽד בְּךָ֖ יְהוָ֣ה חָ֭סִיתִי אַל אֵב֣וֹשָׁה לְעוֹלָ֑ם בְּצִדְקָתְךָ֥ פַלְּטֵֽנִי

verses.restored: Bow down thine ear to me; deliver me speedily: be thou my strong rock, for an house of defence to save me.

familiar.text: Bow down thine ear to me; deliver me speedily: be thou my strong rock, for an house of defence to save me.

modern.text: Incline Your ear to me; come quickly to my rescue. Be my rock of refuge, the stronghold of my deliverance.

original.text: הַטֵּ֤ה אֵלַ֨י אָזְנְךָ֮ מְהֵרָ֪ה הַצִּ֫ילֵ֥נִי הֱיֵ֤ה לִ֨י לְֽצוּר מָ֭עוֹז לְבֵ֥ית מְצוּד֗וֹת לְהוֹשִׁיעֵֽנִי

verses.restored: For thou art my rock and my fortress; therefore for thy name’s sake lead me, and guide me.

familiar.text: For thou art my rock and my fortress; therefore for thy name’s sake lead me, and guide me.

modern.text: For You are my rock and my fortress; lead me and guide me for the sake of Your name.

original.text: כִּֽי סַלְעִ֣י וּמְצוּדָתִ֣י אָ֑תָּה וּלְמַ֥עַן שִׁ֝מְךָ֗ תַּֽנְחֵ֥נִי וּֽתְנַהֲלֵֽנִי

verses.restored: Pull me out of the net that they have laid privily for me: for thou art my strength.

familiar.text: Pull me out of the net that they have laid privily for me: for thou art my strength.

modern.text: You free me from the net laid out for me, for You are my refuge.

original.text: תּוֹצִיאֵ֗נִי מֵרֶ֣שֶׁת ז֭וּ טָ֣מְנוּ לִ֑י כִּֽי אַ֝תָּה מָֽעוּזִּֽי

verses.restored: Into your hand I commit my spirit; you have redeemed me, YHWH, God of truth.

familiar.text: Into thine hand I commit my spirit: thou hast redeemed me, O LORD God of truth.

notes.title: Into your hand I commit my spirit
notes.body: The Hebrew entrusts one’s ruach, “spirit/breath,” to God. Luke 23:46 later places this line on Jesus’ lips; the psalm’s original setting remains a Jewish prayer of trust under threat.

modern.text: Into Your hands I commit my spirit; You have redeemed me, O LORD, God of truth.

original.text: בְּיָדְךָ֮ אַפְקִ֪יד ר֫וּחִ֥י פָּדִ֖יתָה אוֹתִ֥י יְהוָ֗ה אֵ֣ל אֱמֶֽת

verses.restored: I have hated them that regard lying vanities: but I trust in YHWH.

familiar.text: I have hated them that regard lying vanities: but I trust in the LORD.

modern.text: I hate those who cling to worthless idols, but in the LORD I trust.

original.text: שָׂנֵ֗אתִי הַשֹּׁמְרִ֥ים הַבְלֵי שָׁ֑וְא וַ֝אֲנִ֗י אֶל יְהוָ֥ה בָּטָֽחְתִּי

verses.restored: I will be glad and rejoice in thy mercy: for thou hast considered my trouble; thou hast known my soul in adversities;

familiar.text: I will be glad and rejoice in thy mercy: for thou hast considered my trouble; thou hast known my soul in adversities;

modern.text: I will be glad and rejoice in Your loving devotion, for You have seen my affliction; You have known the anguish of my soul.

original.text: אָגִ֥ילָה וְאֶשְׂמְחָ֗ה בְּחַ֫סְדֶּ֥ךָ אֲשֶׁ֣ר רָ֭אִיתָ אֶת עָנְיִ֑י יָ֝דַ֗עְתָּ בְּצָר֥וֹת נַפְשִֽׁי

verses.restored: And hast not shut me up into the hand of the enemy: thou hast set my feet in a large room.

familiar.text: And hast not shut me up into the hand of the enemy: thou hast set my feet in a large room.

modern.text: You have not delivered me to the enemy; You have set my feet in the open.

original.text: וְלֹ֣א הִ֭סְגַּרְתַּנִי בְּיַד אוֹיֵ֑ב הֶֽעֱמַ֖דְתָּ בַמֶּרְחָ֣ב רַגְלָֽי

verses.restored: Have mercy upon me, O YHWH, for I am in trouble: mine eye is consumed with grief, yea, my soul and my belly.

familiar.text: Have mercy upon me, O LORD, for I am in trouble: mine eye is consumed with grief, yea, my soul and my belly.

modern.text: Be merciful to me, O LORD, for I am in distress; my eyes fail from sorrow, my soul and body as well.

original.text: חָנֵּ֥נִי יְהוָה֮ כִּ֤י צַ֫ר לִ֥י עָשְׁשָׁ֖ה בְכַ֥עַס עֵינִ֗י נַפְשִׁ֥י וּבִטְנִֽי

verses.restored: For my life is spent with grief, and my years with sighing: my strength faileth because of mine iniquity, and my bones are consumed.

familiar.text: For my life is spent with grief, and my years with sighing: my strength faileth because of mine iniquity, and my bones are consumed.

modern.text: For my life is consumed with grief and my years with groaning; my iniquity has drained my strength, and my bones are wasting away.

original.text: כִּ֤י כָל֪וּ בְיָג֡וֹן חַיַּי֮ וּשְׁנוֹתַ֪י בַּאֲנָ֫חָ֥ה כָּשַׁ֣ל בַּעֲוֺנִ֣י כֹחִ֑י וַעֲצָמַ֥י עָשֵֽׁשׁוּ

verses.restored: I was a reproach among all mine enemies, but especially among my neighbours, and a fear to mine acquaintance: they that did see me without fled from me.

familiar.text: I was a reproach among all mine enemies, but especially among my neighbours, and a fear to mine acquaintance: they that did see me without fled from me.

modern.text: Among all my enemies I am a disgrace, and among my neighbors even more. I am dreaded by my friends— they flee when they see me on the street.

original.text: מִכָּל צֹרְרַ֨י הָיִ֪יתִי חֶרְפָּ֡ה וְלִשֲׁכֵנַ֨י מְאֹד֮ וּפַ֪חַד לִֽמְיֻדָּ֫עָ֥י רֹאַ֥י בַּח֑וּץ נָדְד֥וּ מִמֶּֽנִּי

verses.restored: I am forgotten as a dead man out of mind: I am like a broken vessel.

familiar.text: I am forgotten as a dead man out of mind: I am like a broken vessel.

modern.text: I am forgotten like a dead man, out of mind. I am like a broken vessel.

original.text: נִ֭שְׁכַּחְתִּי כְּמֵ֣ת מִלֵּ֑ב הָ֝יִ֗יתִי כִּכְלִ֥י אֹבֵֽד

verses.restored: For I have heard the slander of many: fear was on every side: while they took counsel together against me, they devised to take away my life.

familiar.text: For I have heard the slander of many: fear was on every side: while they took counsel together against me, they devised to take away my life.

modern.text: For I hear the slander of many; there is terror on every side. They conspire against me and plot to take my life.

original.text: כִּ֤י שָׁמַ֨עְתִּי דִּבַּ֥ת רַבִּים֮ מָג֪וֹר מִסָּ֫בִ֥יב בְּהִוָּסְדָ֣ם יַ֣חַד עָלַ֑י לָקַ֖חַת נַפְשִׁ֣י זָמָֽמוּ

verses.restored: But I trusted in thee, O YHWH: I said, Thou art my God.

familiar.text: But I trusted in thee, O LORD: I said, Thou art my God.

modern.text: But I trust in You, O LORD; I say, “You are my God.”

original.text: וַאֲנִ֤י עָלֶ֣יךָ בָטַ֣חְתִּי יְהוָ֑ה אָ֝מַ֗רְתִּי אֱלֹהַ֥י אָֽתָּה

verses.restored: My times are in thy hand: deliver me from the hand of mine enemies, and from them that persecute me.

familiar.text: My times are in thy hand: deliver me from the hand of mine enemies, and from them that persecute me.

modern.text: My times are in Your hands; deliver me from my enemies and from those who pursue me.

original.text: בְּיָדְךָ֥ עִתֹּתָ֑י הַצִּ֘ילֵ֤נִי מִיַּד א֝וֹיְבַ֗י וּמֵרֹדְפָֽי

verses.restored: Make thy face to shine upon thy servant: save me for thy mercies’ sake.

familiar.text: Make thy face to shine upon thy servant: save me for thy mercies’ sake.

modern.text: Make Your face shine on Your servant; save me by Your loving devotion.

original.text: הָאִ֣ירָה פָ֭נֶיךָ עַל עַבְדֶּ֑ךָ ה֖וֹשִׁיעֵ֣נִי בְחַסְדֶּֽךָ

verses.restored: Let me not be ashamed, O YHWH; for I have called upon thee: let the wicked be ashamed, and let them be silent in the grave.

familiar.text: Let me not be ashamed, O LORD; for I have called upon thee: let the wicked be ashamed, and let them be silent in the grave.

modern.text: O LORD, let me not be ashamed, for I have called on You. Let the wicked be put to shame; let them lie silent in Sheol.

original.text: יְֽהוָ֗ה אַל אֵ֭בוֹשָׁה כִּ֣י קְרָאתִ֑יךָ יֵבֹ֥שׁוּ רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים יִדְּמ֥וּ לִשְׁאֽוֹל

verses.restored: Let the lying lips be put to silence; which speak grievous things proudly and contemptuously against the righteous.

familiar.text: Let the lying lips be put to silence; which speak grievous things proudly and contemptuously against the righteous.

modern.text: May lying lips be silenced— lips that speak with arrogance against the righteous, full of pride and contempt.

original.text: תֵּ֥אָלַ֗מְנָה שִׂפְתֵ֫י שָׁ֥קֶר הַדֹּבְר֖וֹת עַל צַדִּ֥יק עָתָ֗ק בְּגַאֲוָ֥ה וָבֽוּז

verses.restored: Oh how great is thy goodness, which thou hast laid up for them that fear thee; which thou hast wrought for them that trust in thee before the sons of men!

familiar.text: Oh how great is thy goodness, which thou hast laid up for them that fear thee; which thou hast wrought for them that trust in thee before the sons of men!

modern.text: How great is Your goodness which You have laid up for those who fear You, which You have bestowed before the sons of men on those who take refuge in You!

original.text: מָ֤ה רַֽב טוּבְךָ֮ אֲשֶׁר צָפַ֪נְתָּ לִּֽירֵ֫אֶ֥יךָ פָּ֭עַלְתָּ לַחֹסִ֣ים בָּ֑ךְ נֶ֝֗גֶד בְּנֵ֣י אָדָם

verses.restored: Thou shalt hide them in the secret of thy presence from the pride of man: thou shalt keep them secretly in a pavilion from the strife of tongues.

familiar.text: Thou shalt hide them in the secret of thy presence from the pride of man: thou shalt keep them secretly in a pavilion from the strife of tongues.

modern.text: You hide them in the secret place of Your presence from the schemes of men. You conceal them in Your shelter from accusing tongues.

original.text: תַּסְתִּירֵ֤ם בְּסֵ֥תֶר פָּנֶיךָ֮ מֵֽרֻכְסֵ֫י אִ֥ישׁ תִּצְפְּנֵ֥ם בְּסֻכָּ֗ה מֵרִ֥יב לְשֹׁנֽוֹת

verses.restored: Blessed be YHWH: for he hath showed me his marvellous kindness in a strong city.

familiar.text: Blessed be the LORD: for he hath shewed me his marvellous kindness in a strong city.

modern.text: Blessed be the LORD, for He has shown me His loving devotion in a city under siege.

original.text: בָּר֥וּךְ יְהוָ֑ה כִּ֥י הִפְלִ֘יא חַסְדּ֥וֹ לִ֝֗י בְּעִ֣יר מָצֽוֹר

verses.restored: For I said in my haste, I am cut off from before thine eyes: nevertheless thou heardest the voice of my supplications when I cried to thee.

familiar.text: For I said in my haste, I am cut off from before thine eyes: nevertheless thou heardest the voice of my supplications when I cried unto thee.

modern.text: In my alarm I said, “I am cut off from Your sight!” But You heard my plea for mercy when I called to You for help.

original.text: וַאֲנִ֤י אָ֘מַ֤רְתִּי בְחָפְזִ֗י נִגְרַזְתִּי֮ מִנֶּ֪גֶד עֵ֫ינֶ֥יךָ אָכֵ֗ן שָׁ֭מַעְתָּ ק֥וֹל תַּחֲנוּנַ֗י בְּשַׁוְּעִ֥י אֵלֶֽיךָ

verses.restored: O love YHWH, all ye his saints: for YHWH preserveth the faithful, and plentifully rewardeth the proud doer.

familiar.text: O love the LORD, all ye his saints: for the LORD preserveth the faithful, and plentifully rewardeth the proud doer.

modern.text: Love the LORD, all His saints. The LORD preserves the faithful, but fully repays the arrogant.

original.text: אֶֽהֱב֥וּ אֶת יְהוָ֗ה כָּֽל חֲסִ֫ידָ֥יו אֱ֭מוּנִים נֹצֵ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה וּמְשַׁלֵּ֥ם עַל יֶ֝֗תֶר עֹשֵׂ֥ה גַאֲוָֽה

verses.restored: Be of good courage, and he shall strengthen your heart, all ye that hope in YHWH.

familiar.text: Be of good courage, and he shall strengthen your heart, all ye that hope in the LORD.

modern.text: Be strong and courageous, all you who hope in the LORD.

original.text: חִ֭זְקוּ וְיַאֲמֵ֣ץ לְבַבְכֶ֑ם כָּל הַ֝מְיַחֲלִ֗ים לַיהוָֽה

translation_notes: This chapter completes corpus coverage as a ChatGPT-authored draft. KJV is retained as a familiar comparison layer; a separate automated reference pass adds BSB and pointed Hebrew without replacing the restored draft.
safety_note: Enemy and punishment language is lament poetry, not authorization for retaliation. Illness language must not be moralized.
source_witness_audit_flags: Compare directly with WLC/OSHB, Septuagint, Dead Sea Psalms witnesses where extant, and other textual witnesses during the global audit. Preserve poetic parallelism, superscriptions, duplicate/parallel psalms, and significant Hebrew/Greek divergences rather than harmonizing them.
